faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Programme Branch, ICDS, Khagaria Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Programme Branch, ICDS, Khagaria Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Creche Worker, 1 Assistant Creche Worker.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Programme Branch, ICDS, Khagaria Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 3 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years (Unreserved category, reserved for women) (as on date of publication of the advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 30 days x Rs. 491 per day = 14,730 for Creche Worker, 30 days x Rs. 388 per day = 11,640 for Assistant Creche Worker.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Creche Worker: Graduate pass with 3 years' experience of child-related work in any institution, school, anganwadi or play school. Assistant Creche Worker: 12th pass or Intermediate; childcare experience preferred. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must be citizens of India. Candidates must have Bihar domicile. Both posts are reserved for women. Experience in a government department / institution / office will be given preference.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview of candidates holding the prescribed qualification. Final merit list on the basis of educational qualification, work experience and interview. Selection by a committee chaired by the District Magistrate, Khagaria or an officer nominated by him. Interview information sent to the applicant's email ID and posted on khagaria.nic.in.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract (daily) based posts; appointment is purely temporary. Engagement for 1 year; first three months are probation. Extension decided by the competent authority after review of work by the nodal officer.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Palnaghar (creche), Khagaria.
